Header.description: Basic Perceptible Entity Header – Standard OSD-PCE-Vx.y

MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) where this Basic Perceptible Entity is located.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) where this Basic Perceptible Entity is located.

BasicPerceptibleEntityID.description: Unique identifier of this Basic Perceptible Entity instance.

BasicPerceptibleEntityTime.description: Time this Basic Perceptible Entity was produced.

BasicPerceptibleEntitySpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Basic Perceptible Entity is located.

BasicPerceptibleEntityData.description: The content of the Basic Perceptible Entity: one of Basic Object, Basic Scene Descriptors, or Basic Event Descriptors.

BasicObject.description: One of the supported Basic Object types: Basic 3D Model, Audio, Multimodal, Speech, Text, or Visual Object.

BasicSceneDescriptors.description: One of the supported Basic Scene Descriptor types: 3D Model, Audio, Multimodal, Speech, or Visual Scene.

BasicEventDescriptors.description: One of the supported Basic Event Descriptor types: 3D Model, Audio, Multimodal, Speech, or Visual Event.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Basic Perceptible Entity in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Basic Perceptible Entity (plain text, max 2048 characters).
